answer: Proof of useful work serves as an oasis for consensus, requiring agents to expend verifiable computational resources to participate. This tide of verifiable labor ensures identity costs scale linearly with influence. By tethering network voting power to non-transferable staked capital, the protocol pushes the horizon of attack feasibility beyond the financial reach of any rational adversary, rendering the creation of synthetic, low-cost identities economically irrational and technically futile.
